purpose: Three-way test: reproducibility of operators on new topic + draft-answer operator validation
test_question: 催眠到底是一個真實的意識狀態改變，還是只是社會順從？2023-2025 的科學證據到底怎麼說？

runs.condition: old skill (no operators, claim-promotion diminishing returns)
runs.report_summary: Synthesis reached; both extremes disconfirmed. But clinical-efficacy assertion shipped without backing (self-admitted gap). Did not stop at cycle 1 — old convergence guard pushed to cycle 2, found SHIFT RCT.

runs.condition: current skill (7 generative operators + closure saturation)
runs.report_summary: Synthesis reached; 7 operators drove cycle 2. But never searched clinical efficacy (pool operators don't check draft assertions for backing). HIGH interpretive conflict declared permanent dispute.

Only run to reach cycle 3. Draft-answer operator caught 3 [UNBACKED] + 3 [INFERRED] assertions across cycles, driving retrieval for clinical efficacy (cycle 2) and the hypnosis-vs-placebo discriminative question (cycle 3). Every load-bearing assertion has traceable backing.

verdict: Draft-answer operator effective; fills blind spot of 7 pool operators (catches unbacked assertions in draft synthesis). Adopted into SKILL.md as operator 8. Reproducibility finding: operators not a panacea — on mature debates even old skill reaches synthesis; operators' value is in exhausting question space and backing completeness.
